flow.name: get:\customers:api-config
flow.doc:name: GET /customers
flow.doc:description: Retrieves a list of all customers.

logger.message: #['GET /customers - Retrieving all customers. Correlation ID: ' ++ (correlationId default 'N/A')]
logger.doc:name: Log GET /customers

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- [ { id: "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000", name: "John Doe", email: "john.doe@example.com", phone: "123-456-7890" }, { id: "223e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174001", name: "Jane Smith", email: "jane.smith@example.com", phone: "987-654-3210" } ]
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { id: uuid(), name: payload.name, email: payload.email, phone: payload.phone default null }

flow.name: get:\customers\(customerId):api-config
flow.doc:name: GET /customers/{customerId}
flow.doc:description: Retrieves a specific customer by their unique ID.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { id: attributes.uriParams.customerId, name: "John Doe", email: "john.doe@example.com", phone: "123-456-7890" }
